evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from account creation, game deletion, and other game management stories.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: The invitation method differs from PP-028's capacity limit, so no duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is distinct from adding, selecting, editing, or re-estimating items.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to see all items
evaluations.rationale: Actor differs meaningfully from estimator-facing story PP-031.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection of an item is distinct from the more specific re-estimation workflow in PP-013.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding to the backlog is distinct from starting a round or estimating an item.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from adding, deleting, selecting, or re-estimating an item.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from other item management actions.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-triggered immediate reveal differs from PP-033's participant-facing reveal after all estimates.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: The business rule differs from manual entry in PP-012 and unanimous auto-fill in PP-011.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Unanimous auto-fill differs meaningfully from average acceptance and manual entry.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of an agreed estimate differs from automatic average or unanimous auto-fill.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating a prior story is a more specific workflow than selecting an item, and is not a duplicate of PP-005.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-015's requirement to bring stories in from a spreadsheet; the import/copy-paste wording is not a meaningful enough requirement difference.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-014's spreadsheet story-entry requirement with only a mechanism-level wording difference.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from viewing, exporting, or deleting a game transcript.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is distinct from live scrollback or exporting.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: HTML export is a distinct file format from CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is a distinct file format from HTML export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting an account or an item.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login, account update, and account deletion.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from account creation and password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from account deletion and login.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game or changing account details.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Distinct timezone requirement with no duplicate elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login and account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with modified Fibonacci or powers of 2
evaluations.rationale: Distinct estimation-sequence configuration requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Capacity limit is a meaningfully different business rule from PP-002's URL-based invitation method.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Estimator join flow differs from moderator invitation and account creation.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from seeing all items or prior estimates.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Estimator role differs meaningfully from moderator story PP-004.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Immediate status differs from seeing actual estimates in the current round.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timing and actor differ from PP-009's moderator immediate reveal.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-041: both allow changing an estimate before the draw is completed.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from current-round results and prior-round scrollback.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Current-round estimate details differ from immediate who-has-estimated status.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Starting a timer is distinct from resetting it.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Reset behavior is distinct from manually starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Prior-round scrollback differs from viewing a formal transcript or current-round estimates.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is distinct from estimation, reveal, and timer stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034: both express the same participant's ability to change an estimate before completion.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Unique personalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is distinct from accessibility, browser support, and performance stories.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Unique developer-facing glossary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from user-facing performance and other developer stories.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility differs from standards and accessibility requirements.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is a distinct requirement from general standards or browser compatibility.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: User-facing responsiveness is distinct from developer-facing database index work.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unique internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Unique URL design requirement.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Unique error handling requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results are stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Researcher-focused privacy requirement differs from metrics and other data stories.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics requirement is distinct from researcher non-identifiable storage.
